title: Johnson-Schwartzman Gap Labelling for Metric and Discrete Decorated Graphs
summary: We study Schrödinger operators on metric and discrete decorated graphs. The values taken by the integrated density of states (IDS) on spectral gaps are called gap labels. A natural question is which gap labels can occur. We answer this for graphs arising from uniquely ergodic one-dimensional dynamical systems by proving Johnson-Schwartzman gap-labelling theorems in both the metric and discrete settings.
